svg.metadata: {"id": "s042", "name": "电路实验桌", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "电路", "电与磁", "实验"], "desc": "电学实验台：墙上白板画着电池-开关-灯泡的串联电路图，台面上电池盒、闸刀开关、发光小灯泡和万用表，灯泡会发光。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [620, 1300]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "board", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pegboard", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "drawers", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bench", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "circuit", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bulb_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "meter", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "desk_lamp", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.95, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.05, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "sparks", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#E7EEF8", "wall2": "#D2DDEE", "stripe": "#DCE5F2", "peg": "#F3E3C6", "peg2": "#E2CBA4", "hole": "#C7AD86", "top": "#EBC48D", "top2": "#CF9E62", "cab": "#5C80A8", "cab2": "#4A6A92", "knob": "#F2C14E", "boardw": "#FFFFFF", "ink": "#33475E", "wr": "#E8584A", "wb": "#33475E", "wy": "#F2B33D", "batt": "#2F3A46", "batt2": "#F2B33D", "copper": "#D98E4A", "glass": "#FFF7D6", "bulb": "#FFE07A", "glow": "#FFD25A", "metal": "#9AA6B2", "metal2": "#C9D1DA", "meter": "#F2C14E", "meter2": "#E0A92E", "screen": "#C4ECCD", "leaf": "#6DBA82", "leaf2": "#A6DB95", "pot": "#F2836B", "pot2": "#DA6B55", "d1": "#F2836B", "d2": "#5FB7B0", "d3": "#F7C55E", "d4": "#9B8CE8", "d5": "#7FC4E8"}}
